ca-county-officials.summary: Outside San Francisco, the County card names the county you picked, and not its board of supervisors or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the office looking empty.
ca-county-officials.why: No statewide list of California's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
ca-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's supervisors and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

ca-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the city or town you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
ca-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of California's cities and towns has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
ca-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's and town's mayor and council members, or a city's own published list of them.

ca-school-board-members.summary: The School District cards name the district you picked, and not the members of its board.
ca-school-board-members.why: No list of the board members of California's school districts has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
ca-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

ca-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website where they are known. It does not name any nation's council yet.
ca-tribal-government.why: This app has not read any California nation's council list yet. Most nations publish theirs on their own site, which has to be read one nation at a time.
ca-tribal-government.wanted: Each nation's own published list of its council, read one nation at a time.

sf-amenity-phones.summary: Fire-station and library cards carry no phone number.
sf-amenity-phones.why: The city's fire station and library datasets have no phone number in them — it's missing at the source, not undisplayed.
sf-amenity-phones.wanted: An SFFD station or SFPL branch dataset that includes public phone numbers.

sf-supervisor-contact.summary: Supervisor districts name the supervisor but the boundary source carries no contact fields.
sf-supervisor-contact.why: The city's supervisor district data carries no contact details, so a phone or e-mail has to come from a separate roster.
sf-supervisor-contact.wanted: A DataSF or Board of Supervisors dataset with per-district office phone and e-mail.
